text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: At last, the day of my debut has arrived. With victory, I shall rise to become the new shining star the masses so desire.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: A thunderous declaration! My followers watch in awe as I turn my imposing back and make for the battlefield!
